title: Brannic Mossvein
kicker: a kid trying not to be the first one to break

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A young Bramble skirmisher peers from a leaf-shadow hood, clutching the collar closed around a bright blue charm and a stitched patch of home-cloth.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: A boy wearing a fighter's hood two sizes too big for his nerve. Keeps touching a scrap of home-cloth from a sibling's work shirt. Wants a place in the camp without becoming cruel enough to keep it.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: Parley path Capture/mercy branch Evidence that the road conflict is bigger than banditry
